by: Claude (scripted pixel retouch, no image generator involved)
about: These frames were captured with run_chapter.py capture, whose candidate record always says origin "generated" and generation_tool "built-in imagegen". For the frames below that record is wrong: each is a hand retouch of the named source version, made with numpy and Pillow (smooth fill or copying neighbouring pixels of the same image). The prompt recorded with each is the region-edit prompt whose fault the retouch addresses.

frames.what: Sky above the treeline: the edit left a visible seam; rows 296 to 368 colour-matched to the surrounding sky and edge columns smoothed. No new content drawn.
